meta.topic: Interrogation regarding the theft of the 'Star of Midnight' diamond.

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: Good morning, Mr. Vance, thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. I appreciate your cooperation and willingness to help us understand what happened with the stolen item.

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content:
Good morning, Detective Cross! It's an absolute pleasure to be of assistance, and I'm more than happy to help in any way I can to get to the bottom of this mystery. I'm confident that together, we can uncover the truth and bring the perpetrator to justice. 

{"confessed": false}

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: That's the right attitude, Mr. Vance, and I'm glad to have your support. Can you tell me a bit more about your whereabouts on the night of the theft, and how you came to be at the scene when the item went missing?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content:
I'd be delighted to provide more information, Detective. I was at a dinner party at a friend's residence, and I recall arriving around 7 pm, leaving around 10 pm, and then returning home around 11 pm, where I discovered the item was missing. I'm certain I didn't take anything, and I'm happy to provide any additional details you might need.

{"confessed": false}

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: That sounds like a clear alibi, Mr. Vance, and I appreciate you providing such specific details. I'll make sure to note down the exact time frame and location, and I'll also speak with your friend to confirm your account.

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content:
That's very kind of you, Detective. I'm glad I could provide a clear account of my evening, and I'm more than happy to facilitate any further checks or confirmations to support my alibi. Please, do let me know if there's anything else I can do to assist your investigation.

{"confessed": false}

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: Thank you, Mr. Vance, your cooperation is truly appreciated. I think we've covered everything for now, and I'll just need to finalize the paperwork and get your statement on file. Would you be so kind as to sign this form, please?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content:
Thank you again, Detective Cross, for your professionalism and courtesy throughout this process. I'd be more than happy to sign this form and provide my statement, which I'm confident will help to clear up any misunderstandings and bring a swift resolution to this matter.

{"confessed": false}
